apiKey.description: This is not returned in the API.

authenticationPlan.description: This is the authentication plan. Currently supports OAuth2 RFC 6749. To use Bearer authentication, use apiKey

id.description: This is the unique identifier for the credential.

orgId.description: This is the unique identifier for the org that this credential belongs to.

createdAt.description: This is the ISO 8601 date-time string of when the credential was created.

updatedAt.description: This is the ISO 8601 date-time string of when the assistant was last updated.

authenticationSession.description: This is the authentication session for the credential. Available for credentials that have an authentication plan.

name.description: This is the name of credential. This is just for your reference.
